Windows takes a named kernel semaphore path (CreateSemaphoreW / WaitForSingleObject / ReleaseSemaphore / CloseHandle) and never a file lock - 'Windows has no lock file at all', 'no flock(2) is involved'
the native binary is therefore functionally unnecessary on Windows, yet mandatory at load time purely because of the static import

fix: the repo's existing patchedDependencies mechanism (the patches/node-pty precedent) - a platform-aware install script plus a loadable pure-JS entry; footprint is one new file, one config edit, one regenerated lockfile; no VS, no upstream edit
